title: When “Competency” in Reasoning Opens the Door to Vulnerability: Jailbreaking LLMs via Novel Ciphers
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of jailbreaking Large Language Models (LLMs) using novel and layered cipher encryption. While it references safety alignment with ethical guidelines and analyzes performance across harmful categories like 'Hate Speech', it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks as a primary subject; the inclusion of an 'Ethics Statement' and categories related to harm does not qualify it based on the specified criteria.
